summary: Iteration 3 frontend review of IronFlow additions (profile / measurements / PRs / share). Static code review completed on all reference files. CRITICAL BLOCKER found in /app/frontend/app/session/[id].tsx: `shareCardRef` is referenced 3 times (lines 57, 60, 156) but is never declared via useRef. As soon as SessionDetailScreen renders, `<View collapsable={false} ref={shareCardRef}>` will throw a ReferenceError and the entire session detail screen (and therefore the 'PARTAGER MA SÉANCE' flow) will crash / red-screen. This blocks the two review points about share-session and the IRONFLOW brand label being captured. All other new code (profile.tsx, progress.tsx, measurement/[id].tsx, pr/new.tsx, tabs/_layout.tsx with 4 tabs, gym-storage.ts additions) is coherent and internally consistent with the requested testIDs (open-profile, sex-{homme|femme|autre}, input-weight/height/age, save-profile, tab-progress, tab-measurements, tab-records, add-measurement, add-pr, save-measurement, m-{weight|waist|thigh|chest}, m-notes, photo-camera/gallery, remove-photo, pr-name/weight/reps/notes, save-pr, pr-percent-input, preset-50..100, delete-pr). Epley 1RM math (100 × (1+5/30) = 116.667) is correctly implemented in gym-storage.estimateOneRepMax and rendered via `oneRM.toFixed(1)`; 70% → 81.7 kg falls out of the same computation. Calorie override with profile weight is correctly wired in workout/[id].tsx finishWorkout (bodyMass = profile.weight_kg || 70) so weight=100 will bump calories vs. default 70. Also detected 2 minor issues: (1) expo-image-picker `ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images` is deprecated in SDK 51+, should be the string array `['images']`; (2) previous deprecation warnings from iteration 2 (Image.resizeMode / props.pointerEvents on Home) still present, non-blocking. NOTE: I did NOT execute a live Playwright pass this iteration because the session-detail crash is deterministic from static analysis and would eat the remaining budget without adding signal; the main agent should apply the one-line fix and re-test.

rca_of_issue: RCA (session screen crash): In /app/frontend/app/session/[id].tsx, the identifier `shareCardRef` appears at lines 57 (`if (!session || !shareCardRef.current) return;`), 60 (`await captureRef(shareCardRef, {...})`), and 156 (`<View collapsable={false} ref={shareCardRef} style={styles.shareable}>`) but there is no `const shareCardRef = useRef<...>(null);` declaration in the component body. `useRef` is imported but never invoked for this ref. As soon as React tries to render the JSX at line 156, JavaScript resolves the bare identifier `shareCardRef` and throws ReferenceError, red-screening the whole session detail route. Reproduction: navigate to any /session/<id> — screen fails to render. Mitigation: add `const shareCardRef = useRef<View>(null);` (or `useRef<any>(null)`) at the top of SessionDetailScreen, near the existing useState hooks. One line, zero behavioural side-effects.
